notes: Fixes the Part 2 rail At-a-Glance visibility in Daily Operations. On rail travel days, Today now shows a prominent rail quick-glance immediately below the Today/Tomorrow summary, with transfer time, next train and a View Full Route & Maps button. The widget remounts reliably after date/test changes. Transportation return links now point directly back to the visible Today rail glance.
name: TEE v3.5.14 — Rail Glance Visibility Fix
